The product-owned content configuration of the one-map FFA vertical slice.
It is data, not code: scripts/arena_runtime.py validates it, stages exactly
the artifacts it names, and recomputes 'engineArguments' from the
declarative fields below so the loader can consume that list verbatim.
Every engine-facing value is derived from the pinned ioquake3 tree:
cvars              read by the modules named in each cvar comment below
+map / +addbot     ioq3 code/qcommon/common.c Com_AddStartupCommands and
code/qcommon/cmd.c Cmd_ExecuteString, which forwards an
unknown command to the running server game module
addbot argument order and the 2000/1500 ms delay cadence reproduce
ioq3 code/game/g_bot.c Svcmd_AddBot_f, G_SpawnBots,
BOT_BEGIN_DELAY_BASE and BOT_BEGIN_DELAY_INCREMENT
readyMarkers       exact Com_Printf strings of the pinned sources
r_mode, r_customwidth and r_customheight are deliberately absent: the loader
derives them from the live canvas box, and a committed value would be an
environment-specific one.
The game directory is 'arena' and not ioquake3's 'baseq3' on purpose: with
com_basegame set to baseq3 the engine demands the retail pak0..pak8 and
refuses to start (code/qcommon/files.c FS_CheckPak0), while any other game
directory selects standalone operation. The engine also requires a readable
default.cfg in that directory, which is what configFiles supplies.

cvarNotes.bot_enable: ioq3 code/game/g_bot.c:761: Svcmd_AddBot_f (g_bot.c:752) returns immediately when this is 0
cvarNotes.com_basegame: ioq3 code/qcommon/files.c: the game directory the pack and QVMs are placed in; any name other than 'baseq3' selects standalone operation in FS_CheckPak0
cvarNotes.fraglimit: ioq3 code/game/g_main.c: the arena profile of content/pack-recipe.json
cvarNotes.headmodel: ioq3 code/client/cl_main.c defaults it to the unpackaged 'sarge'
cvarNotes.model: ioq3 code/cgame/cg_players.c: DEFAULT_MODEL 'sarge' is not in the audited pack, so the fallback would be fatal
cvarNotes.net_enabled: ioq3 code/qcommon/net_ip.c: this work package is strictly offline
cvarNotes.r_allowResize: ioq3 code/sdl/sdl_glimp.c: adds SDL_WINDOW_RESIZABLE so a canvas resize reaches the engine
cvarNotes.sv_maxclients: ioq3 code/game/g_main.c: slots for the local player and the bots
cvarNotes.sv_pure: ioq3 code/qcommon/files.c:1419: FS_FindVM (files.c:1398) only considers a loose vm/*.qvm in a directory search path while fs_numServerPaks is 0, so the QVMs written beside the pack are findable only on an impure client
cvarNotes.timelimit: ioq3 code/game/g_main.c: the profile ends on the frag limit

readyMarkerNotes.clientEnteredGame: ioq3 code/game/g_client.c:1026 — printed for EVERY client that begins, the local player first, so it is not evidence that a bot joined; the bots are matched by name against profile.bots instead
